text:
Maria: Heads-up: PR #4321 in the migration-guide has a couple broken links and no reviewers assigned. Planning to merge in this morning's doc window unless someone claims it.

Devon: I can pick this up — will fix the broken relative link and run the preview. Ping me if you need the branch.

DocsBot: Preview build for PR 4321: https://preview.redwoodai.com/pr/4321 — ⛔ build failed (link-check).

Devon: Thanks bot. Looks like this snippet points to `/beta/api` which 404s in preview. Snippet:```md
See the new API at /beta/api/models
```
I'll patch to `/v1/models` and re-run.

Linda: @Devon also the JS SDK example still uses `Model.generate()` — should be `client.responses.create()` per the latest SDK. Might be worth adding a short note about the change.

Sam: If Devon's handling the fixes, can we avoid a force-merge? Need a second reviewer from rotation. @Tara are you available for a quick LGTM?

Tara: Can do a quick pass in ~20m. If Devon pushes the fix now I can review and approve before the merge window.

Maria: Awesome — Devon it's yours. FYI merge window closes at 11:30 PT. Please add the `needs-reviewer` label when ready.

Devon: Pushed fix, re-triggered preview: `yarn docs:preview --pr 4321`

DocsBot: Preview for PR 4321: https://preview.redwoodai.com/pr/4321 — ✅ build succeeded. Link checks passed.

Tara: LGTM. Left one tiny wording nit on the migration note, not blocking.

Maria: Thanks — merging after CI green. @Devon please squash & merge and set commit message to "docs(migration): fix links + sdk snippet"

Devon: Done. Thanks team :tada:
